messages:
Eli Walker: Heads-up from ACME finance: March statement missing expected token usage. They say many requests returned 429 then succeeded on retry, but invoice doesn't include retries. Can we check?
Priya Nair: Which metric are they worried about? tokens vs embeds?
Eli Walker: Tokens. They attached a few session IDs showing a 429 followed by a success.
Sam Ortiz: I pulled the raw edge events for org_id=acme-inc for 2026-03-25 09:12-09:30 UTC. Lots of 429 spikes and then immediate retries. Our ingestion dedupe rule currently collapses request ids that differ only by suffixes like "-retry".
Dana Reed: Sample lines?
Sam Ortiz: paste: ```json
{"time":"2026-03-25T09:12:03Z","org":"acme-inc","req_id":"req_ab12","status":429,"tokens":250}
{"time":"2026-03-25T09:12:04Z","org":"acme-inc","req_id":"req_ab12-retry1","status":200,"tokens":250}```
Sam Ortiz: Because we canonicalize req_id by stripping trailing -retry*, the second event was treated as duplicate and marked non-billable in the meter.
Priya Nair: That would undercount. Can you estimate how many tokens we missed in that window?
Sam Ortiz: Quick aggregate from billing mirror (approx dry-run):
```sql
SELECT sum(tokens) as billed_if_counted
FROM billing_events_raw
WHERE org='acme-inc' AND ts >= '2026-03-25T09:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-25T10:00:00Z' AND req_id LIKE 'req_ab12%';
-- billed_if_counted: 237500
-- currently billed: 126000
-- delta: 111500 tokens
```
Sam Ortiz: Delta ~111,500 tokens. Using their tier price that's $11.15.
Eli Walker: Small absolute amount but customer wants a formal correction and CSV for accounting. Priya, can finance approve a one-off credit and a metering backfill?
Priya Nair: Approve the one-off credit of $11.15 and the backfill as long as eng does a dry-run and we get CSV + checksum. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Automated precheck: backfill requires (1) export snapshot (2) dry-run produced (3) finance approval present.
Dana Reed: OK. Sam will run a dry-run backfill that writes to temp_ledger and outputs per-event diffs + checksum. ETA?
Sam Ortiz: Starting dry-run now. Expect CSV + md5 checksum within 3 hours. I'll include original and canonicalized req_ids so we can audit behavior.
Eli Walker: Also note: we need to decide long-term fix. Either stop canonicalizing with simple suffix strip or change billing rule: if there was a 429 then a subsequent 200 with similar payload should be billable.
Priya Nair: Agreed. This is a policy call; small impact but could reoccur. Logged as FIN-2026-031. Please include suggested language for customer communications.
Sam Ortiz: Dry-run results (uploaded to /s3/fin-backfill/dryruns/1800102345.csv) -- CSV contains 482 rows, delta tokens sum=111500, md5=3b9a1d4f6c7e8a9b0c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d
Eli Walker: Draft customer note: "We traced the discrepancy to an internal deduplication heuristic that collapsed retry attempts. We've issued a one-time billing credit for $11.15 and will backfill our metering ledger; attached CSV and audit log. We apologize for any inconvenience." Approve?
Priya Nair: Approve wording. Please CC accounting when you send.
Dana Reed: Engineering action items: (1) run backfill (dry-run validated) (2) push metering patch to not strip retry suffixes OR make retries billable when prior status=429 (3) add automation to detect similar anomalies.
Sam Ortiz: Backfill job scheduled as a controlled write: will run after final sign-off from finance post-review of dry-run CSV. I will also open ENG ticket to change canonicalization behavior.
Eli Walker: Thanks team. Once backfill completes, please update invoice and send final CSV to customer.
billing-bot: Backfill job status: dry-run complete, awaiting finance confirmation to proceed with commit.
